# Entering Models

### Low Entering Model

```{r}
enter_fit_low <- lmer(RdNBR ~ Type * Point_Num + (1|Incid_Name/Transect_ID), data = enter_df_low, REML = TRUE)

tab_model(enter_fit_low)

# Residual diagnostic plots for m1
par(mfrow = c(1, 2))

# Q-Q plot
qqnorm(resid(enter_fit_low), main = "Q-Q Plot of Residuals")
qqline(resid(enter_fit_low), col = "red")

# Residuals vs Fitted
plot(fitted(enter_fit_low), resid(enter_fit_low),
     xlab = "Fitted Values",
     ylab = "Residuals",
     main = "Residuals vs Fitted")
abline(h = 0, col = "red", lty = 2)

par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

### Entering Effect

##Try a Figure with Point_Num

```{r}
# Predictions across all 10 points, for control vs entering
get_pred <- function(fit, sev) {
  ggpredict(fit, terms = c("Point_Num", "Type")) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity = sev,
           x = as.numeric(as.character(x)))
}

pred_pts <- bind_rows(
  get_pred(enter_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))

# x-axis labels: point number, plus distance into treatment for points 6-10
x_labs <- c("-250 to -201", "-200 to -149", "-150 to -101", "-100 to -51", "-50 to -1", "1 to 50", "51 to 100", "101 to 150", "151 to 200", "201 to 250")

get_diff <- function(fit, sev) {
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(fit, ~ Type | Point_Num)
  emmeans::contrast(emm, method = "revpairwise") %>%   # entering - control
    confint() %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity  = sev,
           Point_Num = as.numeric(as.character(Point_Num)))
}

diff_all <- bind_rows(
  get_diff(enter_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_diff(enter_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_diff(enter_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")),
         Zone = if_else(Point_Num <= 5, "Outside Treatment", "Inside Treatment")) 

# Annotation data: High facet only, with matching factor levels
high_df <- data.frame(
  severity = factor("High", levels = levels(diff_all$severity))
)

ggplot(diff_all, aes(x = Point_Num, y = estimate)) +
  # Background highlight for the treatment zone
  annotate("rect", xmin = 5.5, xmax = 10.5, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
           alpha = 0.08, fill = "blue") +

  # Reference lines
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +

  # Main plot layers
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +

  # --- High facet only: Treatment Edge label & arrow ---
  geom_text(data = high_df,
            aes(x = 8, y = 225, label = "Treatment \nEdge"),
            size = 4, color = "blue", inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  geom_segment(data = high_df,
               aes(x = 7, y = 200, xend = 5.5, yend = 120),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.15, "cm"), type = "closed"),
               color = "blue", linewidth = 0.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +

  # Scales & Facets
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, nrow = 1) +

  # Labels & Theme
  labs(x = "Point Number",
       y = "RdNBR Difference (Entering - Control)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

# Predicted values by type 

```{r}
# Annotation data: High facet only, with matching factor levels
high_df <- data.frame(
  severity = factor("High", levels = levels(pred_pts$severity))
)

# Place the label and arrow above the data (y values are now raw RdNBR, not differences)
y_max <- max(pred_pts$conf.high)
y_min <- min(pred_pts$conf.low)
y_rng <- y_max - y_min

dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.4)

ggplot(pred_pts, aes(x = x, y = predicted, color = group, shape = group, group = group)) +

  # Main plot layers
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = conf.low, ymax = conf.high),
                width = 0.2, linewidth = 0.6, position = dodge) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5, position = dodge) +
  geom_point(size = 3, position = dodge) +

  # Scales & Facets
  scale_color_manual(values = c(control = "grey", entering = "darkblue")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:10) +
  facet_wrap(~severity, nrow = 1) +

  # Labels & Theme
  labs(x = "Point Number",
       y = "Predicted RdNBR",
       color = "Type", shape = "Type") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 13) +
  theme(strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
# Use whatever the factor is called in your models (Point_F, or Point_Num if you converted it in place)
pt_var <- "Point_Num"

get_pred <- function(fit, sev) {
  ggpredict(fit, terms = c(pt_var, "Type")) %>%
    as_tibble() %>%
    mutate(severity = sev,
           x = as.numeric(as.character(x)))   # factor levels -> numeric
}

pred_pts <- bind_rows(
  get_pred(enter_fit_low,  "Low"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_mod,  "Moderate"),
  get_pred(enter_fit_high, "High")
) %>%
  filter(!is.na(predicted)) %>%
  mutate(severity = factor(severity, levels = c("High", "Moderate", "Low")))
```
